purpose: Experiment 3 improved primary only modestly while the current one-negative within-user logistic loss leaves a material uncertainty about whether its sampling/objective mismatch limits top-five placement, particularly in weak tab and item-frequency slices. Retrieve evidence needed to choose a single efficient objective or sampling change rather than guessing.
query: Empirical and theoretical recommender-ranking literature comparing one-negative BPR/pairwise logistic training with multi-negative pairwise or listwise softmax objectives for optimizing nDCG@5 in implicit-feedback, per-user candidate-set ranking. Focus on conclusions that support a minimal objective-only ablation, including negative sampling choices, temperature, and computational cost.

purpose: Experiment 3 improved primary with a same-user pairwise loss, but the retrieved RankNet/ListNet guidance requires a genuine within-request candidate-group identifier. Resolving whether such groups can be reconstructed is material before proposing another pairwise/listwise objective, hard-negative curriculum, or group-complete batching experiment.
query: KuaiRand-Pure interaction-log schema and ranking-decision grouping: determine whether the supplied standard-exposure logs contain a stable request, session, slate, impression-batch, timestamp, position, or event identifier that can reconstruct candidates jointly eligible at one ranking decision; document field availability at impression time and any cautions against treating all rows for a user as one candidate group.
